svg.title: Workshop flow
svg.desc: Run 00-start-here first. The main path goes through steps 01 to 05. A fast track goes from 00 directly to step 03 and continues with steps 04 and 05. Optional notebooks in the additional-topics folder extend steps 03 and 05. Always finish with 99-clean-up.
svg.text: Optional notebooks are in the additional-topics folder. Run them after the step they extend.
